description: Machine-readable source of truth for WattKind AI + StudyKind design tokens. Canonical prose lives in ../../BRAND-GUIDE.md; this file is what the WattKind website (assets/styles.css) and the StudyKind app (web/src/publicBrand.css, shared/rewards.ts) derive their values from. Keep the two in sync.

coral.role: Care, emphasis, active states. Fills, gradients and marks ONLY — fails AA as text.

coralText.role: AA-safe coral for text, links and icon strokes on light surfaces (~5.7:1 on white).

coralDisplay.role: Large display accents only — lockup tagline second phrases and oversized display lines. Not for body text or links (fails AA at small sizes).

sunshine.role: Encouragement, highlights, warm gradient accents. Fill only, not text.

cloud.role: Neutral surface / text on dark bands.

creamRaised.role: Raised warm surface (nav, cards) one step lighter than Cream.

warmLine.role: Warm hairline border/divider on Cream surfaces.

warning.role: Attention. Sunshine is a fill, not text.

error.role: Validation and blocking errors. Reserve for genuine problems.

gradient.note: White text on the primary Coral→Tangerine gradient is an accepted WCAG 2.2 AA exception (2.78:1 to 2.32:1 across the ramp) — see “White on the warm gradient — accepted exception (22 Aug 2026)” in ../../BRAND-GUIDE.md.

typography.fontHeading: "Nunito", ui-rounded, "Arial Rounded MT Bold", system-ui, sans-serif

darkMode.note: Lighten warm accents (coral/tangerine to ~#FF8C82+) when used as text/icons on dark; keep gradients for fills. Every unlockable palette must pass AA independently.
